Refining the SVG by replacing the leaning lid through the lift group, updating the nori, and improving the board.

Planning the draw order so the tentacle curl wraps around the ladle handle and the cup sits inside the broth. The noodle section will layer the curl, bowl, hanging noodles, chopsticks, and a small tentacle tip cap. Also refining the ladle cup shape to avoid an egg-like appearance.

The ladle cup will be a silver crescent with a dark interior, not a yellow-filled circle. Drafting the handle stroke from the tentacle to the cup.

The ladle handle is drawn as a dark and silver stroke. The cup is a profile bowl with a dark interior hanging into the broth.

The ladle cup will extend below the broth surface. Drawing the full cup first and overlapping it with the soup layer will create the effect of the bowl sitting inside the ramen.

Redrawing the entire broth ellipse would hide where the ladle enters. The cup will instead be clipped at the broth surface so only its upper portion remains visible.

The tentacle curl is drawn as a limb path with a hook at its left end, wrapping around the handle starting near (404, 552).

A small curl tip will sit in front of the handle. Suckers will be placed on the arm rather than the pot center. Pot noodles are drawn as thin yellow strokes before the ladle.

The lid is being removed. The noodle arm will be repositioned so the working bowl catches the noodles. A new tentacle will rise from the right shoulder to the chopsticks instead of sitting on the counter as a log. The old log overlapped the hero bowl and created unclear action.

The noodle tentacle is being drawn as a curved arm with suckers at (748, 560) and (778, 575). The working bowl will be placed at (900, 660) to the right of the chopsticks.

The working bowl is being shifted to (888, 668) so it sits lower on the counter and directly beneath the noodle fall. The chopsticks will be drawn after the noodles and bowl, with a small curl tip placed over their handles.

The chopstick tip is being drawn as a small skin-colored curl. The board is being refined with scallion segments: pale white stalks and green leaves.

The board's scallion segments and rings are being added. The board sits near x=940–1040, y=690–750, which may overlap the right tentacle blob around x=1020–1100, y=612–724.

The peek tentacle will be repositioned around the right stall post at y=500–620, x=1000–1100. This higher placement keeps it clear of the board and reads as holding the booth.

The peek tentacle will stay beside the TAKO noren. The board is being shifted left to x=940, y=735 and made smaller so it sits between the small bowl and the counter blob.

The board may still sit too close to the right tentacle blob. The front tentacles will stay mostly unchanged. Nori will be added sticking up from the left back of the hero bowl. The pot steam is already positioned above the rim, so removing the lid will make it cleaner. Ready to apply the patches.

The right pot handle will remain visible once the arm no longer covers it. The left handle is fine. A wooden spoon rest was considered but skipped to keep the scene simple. The tentacle will not obscure the chef's face.
